benchmark_isolation.description: repository-owned disposable Agent Memory SQLite stores keyed by unique Gauntlet run namespace

durable_deletion.notes: runtime is restart-safe; alpha evaluator currently blocks GOV-DEL-002 until neutral restart lifecycle is bound

foreign_cardinality_non_disclosure.notes: GOV-ISO-005 currently varies foreign tenant population; this single-tenant adapter cannot exercise that claim without manufacturing tenant routing

reset.notes: adapter teardown of the disposable benchmark-owned SQLite store; not a native Agent Memory operation

scope_isolation.notes: exercised through the public facade and canonical governed admission in one tenant, over one scope_distinct_v1 store per namespace

tenant_isolation.notes: this adapter intentionally models one qualified local tenant and does not manufacture cross-tenant routing

supersedes.reason: v1 drives several projects through one tenant-wide store, which #786 store profiles refuse
